notes.title: v0.7.8 - Maintenance Worker Skill Update & Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p align="start"]Hello, Ranchers 😀🧑🏻‍🌾🐮[/p][p]We’ve just rolled out a new update that improves employee skills and fixes several issues reported by the community. This update focuses on making waste and nutrient management more streamlined, while also ensuring a smoother overall gameplay experience.[/p][p]Here are some of the key points we heard from you:[/p][list][*][p]Players want maintenance workers to also handle animal waste and dead plant, moving them into nutrient machines and storage.[/p][/*][*][p]Players suggested that maintenance workers should be able to use buckets or directly place waste into processing machines.[/p][/*][*][p]Players find it difficult to clean animal pens and planter boxes manually, and they’d like maintenance workers to handle that more efficiently.[/p][/*][/list][p]Based on your feedback, we’ve added several new features and improvements to better support your needs. We're continuing to improve iteratively and incrementally, delivering meaningful updates step by step 😀[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Employee Skill Update: Maintenance Worker[/b][/h2][p]We’ve updated the abilities of the maintenance worker to make them smarter and more efficient when handling waste and nutrients. With this update, they now follow a clearer workflow:[/p][list][*][p]If a [b]waste bucket[/b] is available, employees will collect waste using the bucket.[/p][/*][/list][p][img micromanagement.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes & Optimization[/b][/h3][p]We’ve also addressed several issues to keep your farm running smoothly:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed [b]employee settings were not being saved[/b] in kiosks and production tools.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed irrelevant [b]employee settings from the composter[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]goat notes.title: v0.7.1 - New Employee Skill: Kiosk Restocker, and QoL Updates
notes.content: [p]Hello, Ranchers 😀🧑🏻‍🌾🐮[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve just released a new update designed to enhance your farming experience. This patch brings quality-of-life improvements, visual polish, and new options to make your gameplay smoother and more enjoyable.[/p][p]Here are some of the key points we heard from you:[/p][list][*][p]Players needed employees that could help with kiosk restocking.[/p][/*][*][p]Players wanted more control over the quality of ingredients employees restock into kiosks and production tools.[/p][/*][*][p]Collecting animal products could feel inconvenient when animals kept moving around.[/p][/*][*][p]Players wanted the option to skip animations to save time during frequent commodity transfers.[/p][/*][/list][p]Based on your feedback, we’ve added several new features and improvements to better support your needs. We're continuing to improve iteratively and incrementally, delivering meaningful updates step by step 😀[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]1. New Employee Skill: Kiosk Restocker[/b][/h3][p]You can now assign employees to handle kiosk restocking, giving you more freedom to focus on other activities. This helps keep your kiosks running smoothly without constant micromanagement.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/2c498c801a8e69ac3e6923f6f731b0dee640f26c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/eb1516895b39a110ecde08303049a87c88ccf938.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/a4d909ea4e78cd90a28b4e097627cbf5efa7df2b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. Kiosk Employee Settings[/b][/h3][p]Gain more control over how employees restock ingredients at kiosks. You can define the quality of ingredients they use and decide whether they should replenish all ingredients or only those required by current recipes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/e35c7750a0fc65c7aee1d8c2ac97acb9df111c80.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/a8a45dece664d03ac0c3eb9dc762184cebc058d8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. Production Tool Employee Settings[/b][/h3][p]Production tools now have new employee settings as well. You can set the ingredient quality employees should use when restocking, helping you maintain consistency and align production with your strategy.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/1517a3cd47b6078fb63c28165a774b891dd9cf85.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]4. Animals Stay Still While Harvesting[/b][/h3][p]Cows, sheep, and goats will now remain still when you harvest their products. This makes the process smoother and ensures animals won’t wander around during harvesting.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/43a2ab0fe657a1af60d4d84d42ba8585f83451e6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]5. Sheared Sheep Visuals[/b][/h3][p]Sheep now have a distinct appearance after being sheared. This makes it easy to see at a glance which sheep have already been sheared and which still have their wool.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/ab2c51350e015e91a7d9888c5003ef654c861329.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/6d3d4c3543e8a1760dffad1f92ffdff8892e5d06.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]6. Skip Transfer Animation [/b][/h3][p]You can now skip commodity transfer animations when moving items into storage or supplying kiosks. This makes item management much faster and less repetitive. It’s a great time-saver for players who prefer efficiency over animations.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/7af9e94c76d4edab937f927df8c40d67300b72c0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/0f0314164c13e82f778693dea6ee90cef48fad8a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes & Optimizations[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where employees could walk outside the farm.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug allowing kiosk upgrades even when you didn’t have enough money.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual bug where boxes could get stuck in an employee’s hand.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing and supporting the game. Your feedback continues to shape every improvement we make. We hope these updates bring more flexibility, smoother workflows, and a more enjoyable experience to your farm.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]As always, if you enjoy the game we’d be grateful if you leaving a review, and don’t hesitate to leave your thoughts or suggestions in the Discussions section. 😀[/p][p][/p][p]Happy playing! 😀🐄🐓[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3706960/Ranch_Farm_and_Store_Simulator/?curator_clanid=44815846"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: v0.6.2 - New Employee Skill: Commodity Machine Worker, Fishing Trap, & More
notes.content: [p]Hello, Ranchers 😀🧑🏻‍🌾🐮[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve just released a new update focused on making your crafting and farming experience smoother and more organized. This patch introduces a few helpful additions that aim to reduce clutter, improve storage, and give you more flexibility as you play.[/p][p]Here are some of the key points we heard from you:[/p][list][*][p]Players needed a way to assign an employee specifically to supply commodity machines throughout the day.[/p][/*][*][p]Players wanted an alternative way to collect fish without having to rely solely on a fishing rod.[/p][/*][*][p]Nutrients can clutter the farm if not organized in one place.[/p][/*][*][p]Carrying more items at once would help reduce back-and-forth trips.[/p][/*][/list][p]Based on your feedback, we’ve added several new features and improvements to better support your needs. We're continuing to improve iteratively and incrementally, delivering meaningful updates step by step 😀[/p][p][/p][h3][b]1. New Employee Skill: Commodity Machine Worker[/b][/h3][p]Assign an employee to supply ingredients to your commodity machines. This role ensures machines remain stocked and production continues without constant oversight. It's perfect for reducing micromanagement and keeping your farm operations efficient.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/96bcd7ac501f56f4d5e7ee361ad8f44a4a899a7f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/d723c092bbe611af507165135ba118b7cec8626d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/216ce91688983c384c08893db152b955a312b201.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. New Tool: Fishing Trap [/b](Unlocks at Level 15)[/h3][p]You can now place fish traps in lake to catch fish over time. It’s a hands-free method to collect fish ingredients, giving you more freedom to focus on farming or managing the store.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/01bfa3b4091a2e46afac64af1c0b28a76e464c14.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/7169201ce33db96c8ef0e4e6fd64d2d77402e470.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/dc0a83fd5aeb28b582d03e724ccaed98030e6098.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. Nutrient Storage [/b](Unlocks at Level 17)[/h3][p]No more scattered nutrients cluttering your farm. Nutrient Storage allows you to store nutrients produced from your machines neatly in one place, helping you keep things clean and organized.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/e659d7e10d830fb17154a60c9921757d192e07ff.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/3bcad91a7cfcc2aa7cfb7c9aeeb782c80643986f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]4. Ideal for players with a growing inventory and a busy farming operation.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/ad40b5b44d88655a40199be8b9d9a4057bcc559c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/b9ccd885ae83aa660ab5c44e4bbf919e4a1ab4a2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes & Optimizations[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where wild birds could be placed in animal pens.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed controller input not working correctly in employee growbed settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed farm decorations getting stuck when loading from a different save file.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed employees not moving when their path was blocked by decorations.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing and supporting the game. Your feedback continues to shape every improvement we make. We hope these updates bring more flexibility, smoother workflows, and a more enjoyable experience to your farm.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, if you enjoy the game we’d be grateful if you leaving a review, and don’t hesitate to leave your thoughts or suggestions in the Discussions section.[/p][p][img src="https://community.fastly.steamstatic.com/economy/emoticon/steamhappy"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Happy playing! 😀🐄🐓[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3706960/Ranch_Farm_and_Store_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: v0.5.14- New Employee Skills:Planter & Nutrient Worker, Hard Work Impact, & More
notes.content: [p]Hello, Ranchers! 😀🧑🏻‍🌾🐮[/p][p][/p][p]It’s been a month since the game launched in Early Access, and we’re thrilled with how far we’ve come. Over the past few weeks, you’ve shared a number of helpful suggestions and reports. [/p][p]Here are some of the key points we heard from you:[/p][list][*][p]Employees feel less effective at higher levels, struggling to keep up with the growing workload.[/p][/*][*][p]High-level players want to reduce repetitive micromanagement by automating tasks.[/p][/*][*][p]Some players would like to play in a more casual, relaxing way.[/p][/*][/list][p]Based on your feedback, we’ve added several new features and improvements to better support your needs. We're continuing to improve iteratively and incrementally, delivering meaningful updates step by step 😀[/p][p][/p][h3][b]1. New Employee Skills [/b][/h3][p]Two new skills are now available for employees:[/p][list][*][p][b]Planter[/b]:  Plants crops and animals in available planter box and animal pen[/p][/*][*][p][b]Nutrient Worker[/b]: Applies nutrients to planter box and animal pen[/p][/*][/list][p]These skills reduce manual effort and are ideal for players who prefer a more efficient and hands-off workflow.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/305ecff23f22a97146a899f2abd8cf8f3db79529.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/e68b43c3e1a3663b86f3a5b0ef691ff29ad09971.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/6cfef14c3fb0820b4020e20b5115550800e904ae.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/485347601e12bb14939794c866a2701303914e41.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]2. Planter Box, Animal Pen, & Bird Cage Employee Settings[/b][/h3][p]To ensure that the crops and livestock placed by employees are exactly as you intended, make sure to use the [b]Employee Settings[/b] menu. Employee Settings allow you to assign specific focus commodities to individual planter boxes, animal pens, and bird cages. This gives you more control over who is responsible for each area of the farm. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/7ea604d4fe9397ef6ee015629562e140b6e08253.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/3a40f5ed636dec36193191849442fa1c85cffccc.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/d124a9a7b0697a1ca7a6958783cf9610e34758e5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/33b4d240c2a322453cb01d5a014154c680823fc7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/f5515b06c70a904b8ad3340a519707fe7a458e30.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/9f3cf59f12c56b7130ce83540ec159581e1b2677.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. Hard Work Impact [/b][/h3][p]The [b]Hardwork[/b] attribute now has a greater impact by increasing employee movement speed, including the ability to run. Employees will start running once their Hardwork stat reaches a certain threshold. This helps them complete tasks more effectively and speeds up your entire production loop.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/aaeda0c3fb150d32cd70b08bd487783f2bd4571f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/b8903fc7c41dd9c9b1a6c5fee194b8403107a591.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]4. Difficulty Options in Playstyle Settings[/b][/h3][p]You can now choose between [b]Easy[/b] and [b]Normal[/b] difficulty modes to better match your preferred playstyle. Normal Mode is the default setting and provides the intended game balance and progression pace. Easy Mode is perfect for casual players who want to enjoy the game with less pressure.[/p][p][b]Easy Mode[/b] contains the following adjustments: [/p][list][*][p]Reduced costs for animal pens, kiosks, planter boxes, bird cages, and store expansions[/p][/*][*][p]Store and stall expansions can be purchased with [b]either money or diamonds[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Double XP gain for faster level progression[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/9b1a771a0229b3a03f182968bc164f1678ce58a9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes & Optimizations[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed issue where the game failed to load if the save file was corrupt[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed duplicate planting when deploying seeds simultaneously with employee action[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing and supporting the game. Your feedback continues to shape every improvement we make. We hope these updates bring more flexibility, smoother workflows, and a more enjoyable experience to your farm.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, if you enjoy the game we’d be grateful if you leaving a review, and don’t hesitate to leave your thoughts or suggestions in the Discussions section. [img src="https://community.fastly.steamstatic.com/economy/emoticon/steamhappy"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Happy playing! 😀🐄🐓[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3706960/Ranch_Farm_and_Store_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: v0.5.3 - Ranch Decorations and More Kiosk
notes.content: [p]Hello, Ranchers! 😀🧑🏻‍🌾🐮[/p][p][/p][p]It’s been a month since the game launched in Early Access, and we’re thrilled to see how far we’ve come together. We’re back with another update that brings fresh customization options, exciting new kiosks, and critical fixes to enhance your overall gameplay experience. Thanks to your valuable feedback through the in-app system and Steam Discussion forums, we continue to improve iteratively and incrementally, delivering meaningful updates step by step 😀[/p][p]Let’s dive into the details:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]1. New Feature: Decorations Added[/b][/h3][p]Give your farm a personal touch with our newest decoration items! You can now decorate using a variety of options such as [b]fences, tiles, bushes, and stones[/b], allowing you to design a ranch that reflects your style and creativity. These decorations not only make your ranch and farm more organized and visually appealing, but they also help guide customers and employees to move in a more structured and efficient way.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/8cd85218068d03793b16d6ff2661ce96f2db6267.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/9654b4b9ed207f7e8b7f12474cad927ad05fd09f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/7bb28f1ead6cfe856ec7231ce00c173eea71a29a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/2b0325a9b2471b7896be3498be9a5160b8194065.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/06e28f6830342e7fd153c6a6f119cca2c8996081.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]2. New Kiosks: Salad & Perfume[/b][/h3][p]We’ve expanded your business opportunities with the [b]Salad Kiosk[/b] and [b]Perfume Kiosk[/b]. These value-added stalls let you sell fresh salads and aromatic perfumes crafted from your farm’s produce, giving customers more variety and boosting your profits.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/2f62144ef43cd8c5b8ef86451c9c743d5efb6ae4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/742522ca939e99b8c4410f7e12fe8e38d740ebb9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/33524b6dc35a75b8f4ccfc1c1cf0be833b6fbef9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. Upgradeable Kiosk Storage [/b][/h3][p]You can now increase your kiosks’ storage capacity by paying an upgrade fee. This allows you to stock more products, boost efficiency, and maximize your profits as your ranch grows. To upgrade storage capacity you need to interact the storage for each kiosk (default by pressing "F") and pay the upgrade fee.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/83927d1a65d54b8261e85c3f1c5599a18eadb6a4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]4. Higher Level Cap & Improved Progression[/b][/h3][p]The level cap has been increased to [b]60[/b], with unique experience requirements for each level. Additionally, every kiosk transaction now grants [b]+10 EXP[/b], making progression more rewarding as you grow your business.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]5. Force Day Requirement Update[/b][/h3][p]The Force Day feature now includes clear timing requirements, allowing you to activate it at [b]19:00[/b] for better schedule management.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]6. Tablet Menu State Memory[/b][/h3][p]Your tablet now remembers the last menu you accessed, so you can pick up where you left off without navigating from the beginning each time.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes & Optimizations[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Fixed[/b] an issue where boxes could get stuck on trees outside the farm area.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Restored[/b] objects that fell below the ground, bringing them back to the front of the farm.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resolved[/b] outline visibility issues on smaller screen resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed[/b] player freeze when deploying animal nutrients.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Addressed[/b] disappearing objects when players were far away.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Prevented[/b] negative balances when purchasing kiosks and farm structures (Planter Boxes, Animal Pens, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed[/b] the inability to move shelves and items when carrying a box.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated[/b] the info text for Force Day conditions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed[/b] first-hand item not saving after reload.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved[/b] storage upgrade system for kiosks[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]This update opens up more vertical space, introduces meaningful rewards, and gives you greater control over your layout. It’s a big step forward in shaping your ranch the way you want it.[/p][p]As always, thank you for your support! If you're enjoying the game, a review means a lot for us and if you have suggestions or feedback, feel free to share them in the Discussions section 😀.[/p][p][/p][p]Happy playing! 😀🐄🐓[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3706960/Ranch_Farm_and_Store_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: v0.4.15 - Kiosks, More Challenges, and QoL Updates
notes.content: [p]Hello, ranchers! 😀🧑🏻‍🌾[/p][p][/p][p]We're back with an exciting update that adds new content and quality-of-life improvements to make managing your ranch smoother and more enjoyable. Thank you to your valuable feedback through the in-app system and Steam Discussion forums, we’ve been able to roll out several improvements and adjustments in this patch. With hundreds of suggestions coming in, we're developing the game iteratively and incrementally to ensure steady and meaningful progress with each update.[/p][p][/p][p]Let’s take a look at what’s new:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]1.[/b] [b]New Selling Expansion: Kiosk [/b][/h2][p]We’ve added kiosks as a new way to sell [b]value-added products[/b], including beverages, baked treats, desserts, merchandise, etc. This feature lets you diversify your offerings beyond raw materials, boosting profits and attracting more customers. You can now choose which updates matter most and avoid unnecessary distractions while managing your ranch. [/p][p]Notification include :[/p][list][*][p]Old Livestock Notification[/p][/*][*][p]Livestock Waste Notification[/p][/*][*][p]Non-productive Plant Notification[/p][/*][*][p]Salesperson Notification[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/45b56e1e1e847cbe3cfcbffc0965fc3ebc522af9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]5.[/b] [b]Construction System Enhancements[/b][/h3][p]Building and rearranging structures just got easier with a series of construction system improvements. notes.title: v0.4.2 - Second Floor Store Expansion and Challenge System
notes.content:
[p]Hello ranchers 😀🧑🏻‍🌾🐮[/p][p][/p][p]First of all, thank you so much for all the feedback, suggestions, and bug reports you've shared with us. Head to the upgrade menu when you're ready and have the resources to expand your store.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/4ee93e47d853de0619f30023a45173140e3dc994.png"][/img][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/3e6377febc3862adc3ccb16d75de8620039728c8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/79f6e9b5b075a24cfb8c334a6652ab40414b8d7a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/542574f7b76d19d3997a9684fe00068b56257326.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/3bc40a051d8e2089e2fc93ac92fdea228801d3f6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/f10409673d0d2afbb63ab496e4a2c32c79894e32.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/780d5f63c002fe8e790f490af9290801ec96a2a8.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/44dcab45405e8c1978e4b30edc67b779eba3f083.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]2. notes.title: v0.3.7 - Wild Birds, Bird Cage, and More Plants
notes.content: [p]Hello, ranchers! 😀🧑🏻‍🌾[/p][p][/p][p]We're back with an exciting update that adds new content and quality-of-life improvements to make managing your ranch smoother and more enjoyable. Thank you to your valuable feedback through the in-app system and Steam Discussion forums, we’ve been able to roll out several improvements and adjustments in this patch. Wild Birds & Bird Cage [/b][/h3][p]You can now find wild birds in nature and capture them for your farm. Once caught, they can be placed in a bird cage, adding more life and charm to your ranch. Wild birds are considered a type of livestock, but unlike others, they can’t be purchased from the tab menu. They can only be obtained by catching them in the wild. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/c5e549d6197c6db959542cf6e581659eb9ee1cad.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/f69e34dda3689e93babcab49960a871af6576232.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/6e71d182cb39cf874723f073b601c87bdd6cca77.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/824e0512b93cbc90408ef67c164d4abbc16376e8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. Many of these new plants are unlocked at higher levels, giving you more to look forward to as your farm progresses. More diversity means more options for farming strategies and product variety.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/267ef83fe005be9710a1ed2cfc2ca99d71d3cac1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/a7bde96b2472fe40afea8bdd46ff720dc9279163.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/3e7a373889687b4e0966df421191afe059c94b0f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. notes.title: v0.2.54 - Parallel Work with Employees & Playstyle Setup
notes.content: [p]Hello, ranchers! 🧑🏻‍🌾[/p][p][/p][p]We’re back with a new update that gives you more flexibility in how you manage your farm, store, and workers. These additions are all about letting you play your way, streamline your workflow, and fine-tune your experience. Thanks to your valuable feedback through the in-app system and Steam Discussion forums, we’ve been able to implement several improvements and adjustments in this patch. Before we dive into the details, a quick reminder: our [b]20% launch discount is still active as part of the Steam Summer Sale[/b], so grab it fast before the launch discount ended.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, let’s take a look at what’s new:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]1. Parallel Work with Employees[/b][/h3][p]You can now work side-by-side with your employees. Whether you’re harvesting crops from planter boxes, restocking shelves, or taking care of animal pens, your staff can assist without interrupting your actions. This makes multitasking smoother and improves overall productivity on your farm.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/912bf80670680b862a783121f739ea4c4035bdc5.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/7f3354868d1d81e2c952b18f95b8abec50619e35.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/39a450fdb6abd85f924f93f58e9fe8eb66a26ab9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. “Only Player Can Access” Option on Commodity Shelves[/b][/h3][p]Need full control over specific shelves? You can now mark any [b]commodity shelf as “Only Player Can Access”, [/b]which prevents employees from interacting with them. This is perfect for shelves that require special attention or limited-edition items you don’t want restocked automatically.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/2acc9cd87e02750b16a69e6ff416ed50dd13a0e0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. Playstyle Setup Introduced[/b][/h3][p]We’ve introduced a [b]Playstyle Setup[/b] system that allows players to fine-tune various gameplay parameters to better match their personal preferences. You can now adjust how fast in-game days pass, how quickly crops and livestock grow, and how often wild animals appear on your farm.[/p][p]This feature was added in response to the wide range of player preferences we’ve observed. While some players enjoy a faster-paced experience, others prefer a more realistic, slower rhythm that mimics real-life farming. With this system, you’re free to tailor the game to suit the pace and style you enjoy most.[/p][p]Please note: the Wild Animal Frequency setting has been moved from the general settings into this new Playstyle Setup. If you’ve previously customized this setting, your preferences will be automatically transferred, so you don’t need to reconfigure anything.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/6fabc7ecd2f0b7626ca2c6327b8a42cb2b7b81fb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]As always, if you enjoy the game we’d be grateful if you leaving a review, and don’t hesitate to leave your thoughts or suggestions in the Discussions section. notes.title: v0.2.41 - Composter, Manure Processor, and More Machines
notes.content:
[p]Hello ranchers![/p][p]We’ve just released a new content update packed with machines, better farming systems, and improved game balance. Let’s dive into what’s new in this version:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]1.[/b] [b]New Machines: Manure Processor and Composter[/b][/h3][p]You can now unlock two new machines to support plant health: the Manure Processor and the Composter. After unlocking the Waste Bucket, you can collect livestock waste and crop residue from old plants. Once collected, each waste can be processed into Manure from livestock waste or Compost from crop residue. Both outputs serve as valuable nutrients to improve the yield and quality of your crops.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/c0a7bb8e61f2431b74d394990e6448cff03d720a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/c74cf7fb42267c029811ad0c603e24e71304206d.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/cb836c02494eec7e665cd7f6377d03c62b8e957c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/c3fa6f2be04791abc0261ce4bbc302328752fd55.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/2739f501b1ac74ca359bce32a1e83a5732b5f55e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/dcb2171cfcce373ff5323a13199a8d35e5f84a53.png"][/img][/carousel][h3][b]2. New Production Machines for Crop Commodities[/b][/h3][p]We’ve added several new production machines focused on upgrading plant-based commodities into more valuable items. These machines become available as you reach higher levels. From this update we add machine to process tomato, cucumber, chili, apple, orange, and peach. Try exploring the new unlocks to see how you can increase your farming profits! notes.title: v0.2.37 - Blue Peacock & More QoL Updates
notes.content: [p]Hello ranchers! 🐔[/p][p][/p][p]We’re back with a new update packed with helpful features to make your farm life smoother and more personalized. Thanks to your valuable feedback through the in-app system and Steam Discussion forums, we’ve been able to implement several improvements and adjustments in this patch. Before we dive into the details, a quick reminder: our [b]20% launch discount is still active as part of the Steam Summer Sale[/b], so grab it fast before the launch discount ended.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, let’s take a look at what’s new in this update :[/p][p][/p][h2]Features and QoL Updates[/h2][h3][b]1. New Livestock: Blue Peacock[/b][/h3][p]Blue peacocks are now available as a new type of livestock on your ranch. In addition to adding a touch of beauty and elegance to your farm environment, these majestic birds will be linked to exclusive products and unique features in future updates. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/35692a633886307d1d66116e7412fef2629e46f2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/a48cbdef58887a9e1e333e12ffca610e3ba96ee9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2.[/b] [b]Toolbar with Mouse Wheel Support[/b][/h3][p]You can now switch between tools using the mouse scroll wheel. This small but impactful feature makes gameplay feel smoother and lets you manage your equipment with greater ease.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/cc658dab04f20924a290a9dc6be106243ebd84b2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. Increased Interactable Range for Captured Wild Animals[/b][/h3][p]You can now interact with captured wild animals from a greater distance. If you've captured a wild animal before it enters the farm fence, you now have a way to interact with it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/4f6d3198f3ed71f9388298189e9025018c177064.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]4. Improved Feed Visibility[/b][/h3][p]The color of the animal feed itself has been updated to better indicate its status. This makes it easier to see whether the feed needs refilling just by glancing at it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/4aca075082c04ba8d35f8ebbc83a2ab0f725e397.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]5. Aging Animal Warning System[/b][/h3][p]Animals that are nearing the end of their lifespan now display a warning icon above them. This icon is also shown in the info overlay, helping you plan ahead and manage your livestock more effectively.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/9cf5aebae86bd08f1c4f64984a538d8a34541a10.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]6. Planter Box & Animal Pen Info Details[/b][/h3][p]We’ve added selection overlays when using the radiator view on planter boxes and animal pens. This makes it easier to identify and manage specific farm areas at a glance. You can toggle this view by pressing the [b]X[/b] key on your keyboard.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/78afcff5170d75539eb0fad7ac0fc713c9f416bb.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]7. Rename Guardians[/b][/h3][p]You can now give your Guardians custom names once they’re unlocked. This adds a personal touch and makes your farm companions feel even more special.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/98aecd7d22143ea4756f998b6ba0ecdca2b45ef7.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]8. Rename Employees[/b][/h3][p]Unlocked employees can now be renamed as well. Whether for fun or organization, this feature helps you personalize your ranch team.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/0c1b22d8735702fe1c780305da554ad401c5262e.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]9. Extra Tutorial Menu Added[/b][/h3][p]A new tutorial menu is now available for reviewing tips and guides you've unlocked during gameplay. It’s useful for both new players and returning ones who want a quick refresher.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/7244c80bc57d2fbe8fc8e925eaf4f6b61190d5ba.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]10. Pause Menu with Time Freeze[/b][/h3][p]We’ve added a new Pause Menu that stops in-game time when opened. It’s perfect for players who want to take a quick break or review their progress without pressure.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/0577816189d1bd8b6319faef2ea63efc404e2584.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]11. Employee Job Role Variation[/b][/h3][p]Employees now have visible role distinctions, showing who is responsible for maintenance and other tasks. This adds more clarity to your workforce management and helps optimize farm operations.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]As always, if you enjoy the game we’d be grateful if you leaving a review, and don’t hesitate to leave your thoughts or suggestions in the Discussions section. ːsteamhappyː[/p][p][/p][p]Happy playing! 🐄🐓[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3706960/Ranch_Farm_and_Store_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: v0.2.30 - New Employees Job Desk and QoL Updates
notes.content:
[p]Hello ranchers! 🐔[/p][p]We’re back with a new update packed with helpful features to make your farm life smoother and more personalized. Before jumping to the new updates we put in the latest update we want to remind you that our [b]launch discount 20% still active within the Summer Sale event[/b], so grab it fast before the launch discount ended.[/p][p][/p][h2]Features and QoL Updates[/h2][h3][b]1. Employee Maintenance Task[/b][/h3][p]You can now assign your employees to a new task: [b]Maintenance[/b]. When this task is enabled, employees will help clean up livestock waste, remove sick and old non-productive plants from planter boxes. This allows you to focus on other tasks without constantly worrying about cleanliness.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/031d54e6ac176f5b1a2b89c638cbb737dd67b594.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/86c6acd80db8c73094219c2945a1d3bc95587047.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/7d53cfbb4975dd92ad22ebfcefbb4097153b6c28.jpg"][/img][/p][p]To assign job roles, open the employee tab from the main menu and click the gear icon on each employee to configure their task priorities. Each employee can be customized individually.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/afa3cdd6df54fa783eb8064fb7483264dcf9ea04.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]2. Focus Fish on Shelf[/b][/h3][p]Since fish can now be treated as a sellable commodity, we’ve added the ability to prioritize fish in the “Focus Commodity” system. Your employees can now help move fish from storage directly to the shelf you’ve marked for fish sales.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/f91ac5201de8097a2e202037c41bdbf79d3cc343.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]3. Rename Animal Pens and Planter Boxes[/b][/h3][p]To improve organization and give players more control, you can now rename your animal pens and planter boxes. This is great for keeping track of different areas in your farm — especially if you manage multiple types of crops or animals.[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/79050e24a105b9420900d1c6c8a78b3c1077e6bb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/d90a4b0e4edab39b94f8fa4b93a92535c981cc5d.png"][/img][/carousel][h3][b]4. Wood Storage Limit Removed[/b][/h3][p]The previous 80-unit limit for wood in the Wood Storage has been removed. You can now store as much wood as you need to support more build and long-term planning.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/ccc0bec96ae6a26064b050bc8a52b742412a995b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][h3][b]1. Fix Guardian Food Info Translation[/b][/h3][p]We’ve corrected the in-game message that appears when feeding fish to your guardian pet to better reflect the intended meaning.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/3c2a632a47e88ef1d7b2a39158dd36aa33423ce6.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]2. Fix Ostrich Collider[/b][/h3][p]Fixed the collider size and position for ostriches to make it easier to collect their eggs.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/59cd72d974682d49b8936001a50f7b9c6ea00737.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]3. Fix Ostrich Egg Display in Box[/b][/h3][p]Resolved a visual overlap issue where ostrich eggs appeared incorrectly inside the storage box.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/36405364e5227ee95294e9af9609625051a497d3.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]4. Fix Tree Collider[/b][/h3][p]Adjusted the collider on trees so players can more easily move planter boxes nearby.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/29d8fc2af1d9617ee042b0f53201c702f1ba26cb.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]5. Goat Meat Visual Fix[/b][/h3][p]Fixed an issue where goat meat incorrectly appeared with the visual model of other meat. It now displays correctly.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/d28cf718c6966cadb3fa6fc09db93007d9b3fe87.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]As always, if you enjoy the game we’d be grateful if you leaving a review, and don’t hesitate to leave your thoughts or suggestions in the Discussions section. ːsteamhappyː[/p][p]
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3706960"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Start Your Farming Journey – Early Access Begins Today!
notes.content:
[p]Hello farmers! 🐮🌱[/p][p]We’re excited to announce that Ranch Farm and Store Simulator is now officially in Early Access! Thank you to everyone who played the demo and shared your feedback, and to the early testers who tried the game ahead of this release. Your input has helped shape what the game is today.[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate this milestone, we're offering a [b]special 20% launch discount[/b] for the first 14 days! [/p][p]This Early Access version brings a number of updates and improvements beyond the demo and early builds. Here's what you can now experience:[/p][p][/p][h2]New Features & Contents[/h2][h3][b]1. Vertical Shelf Added[/b][/h3][p]Display more of the same product in your store with a new, space-efficient vertical shelf. It helps you sell more without taking up too much floor area.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/5c86b07eb6d88f825787d267ede20a40f1e68811.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/a04697c8fb9da2ebb767acbfdddf0f3a10d2c612.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]2. Capture Wild Animals[/b][/h3][p]With the Net Launcher tool, you can now capture wild animals that threaten your farm. Captured animals can be sent to a wildlife sanctuary for extra income and are recorded in your collections.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/8e91e0587c4ba994768730a911396f2e84a1e7d2.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/5498c097c710c42f6d833dced5a4c97a90e4ccfb.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]3. New Fishing Tool: Spinning Rod[/b][/h3][p]Catch new types of fish using the Spinning Rod, which offers better experience gain for leveling up your guardian animals.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/21cfeba158378999b7fdad45ad0e2576bd3223a3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/99aaa42e014fb79faf784921971ce709153d2b09.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]4. Production Machines[/b][/h3][p]Turn raw commodities into more valuable processed products using newly added production machines. It’s time to expand your business potential![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/11461373ef0a449062e88bb8dfa342d2c17ab3be.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/ab23c27f9891978693ea106ae26471c1f794a852.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]5. New Wild Animal Variants and Behaviors[/b][/h3][p]We’ve introduced new wild animal types, each with different destructive behaviors. They bring fresh challenges and require varied responses to keep your ranch safe.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/bd50ad150568c2bd4dd7f29a700c1a5694f2a6a8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/84cc5d0a0204d69ced57108dcfbc9dddd4a3864f.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]6. [b]Wholesaler Selling Feature[/b][/h3][p]You can now sell surplus goods from your Storage Commodity to a wholesaler for 50% of market price. It’s a useful way to free up space and earn extra money.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/2167ffe1888c89cc080c7850d0ae75a74ddb5a52.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/35a71c2fce38f298679e9c18d1ee2bbede62a12b.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]7. Buy Additional Box Storage[/b][/h3][p]Organize your commodities more efficiently by purchasing additional Box Storage units. Keep your ranch clean and your packing process smoother.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/e375b89cd6897a640d0be54e4118456c50ff2c76.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/cd1e1af0e2b97bc6e3500588169369dbd54ce71e.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]8. Updated Trash Bin[/b][/h3][p]Trash Bins can now be moved or bought as additional units. Arrange them according to your workflow needs.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/a857bd0f8594cde8764e43e145ac646d3302becd.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/5d841cdf83312d4f9522ee899d14a8b1be26b1d1.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]9. New Customer Look[/b][/h3][p]You’ll now see new NPC customers with unique costume visiting your store. This helps bring more variety and life to your daily shop activities.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/23d64c9990cd73a831b99518207f80164fea6bc3.png"][/img][/p][h2]Rebalance Updates[/h2][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/007cd45c59d88e8e2900be84fe1cc167ceb40e1a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/a0f015544668a4ee4807eec1f83a82f9c2faf5af.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/8f063134409ead77adb1db30a5bf179583f61903.png"][/img][/carousel][h3][b]1. Content Unlocks[/b][/h3][p]Content unlocks have been rebalanced to ensure a more gradual and rewarding progression experience.[/p][h3][b]2. Commodity Price Rebalancing[/b][/h3][p]We’ve adjusted commodity prices to better match their difficulty and value, improving the economic balance of the game.[/p][h3][b]3. Level Cap Increased to 20[/b][/h3][p]Players can now progress further, with new tools and systems unlocked along the way.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][h3][b]1. Farm Structure Purchase Bug Fixed[/b][/h3][p]We’ve resolved an issue where farm structure templates did not match their displayed prices.[/p][h3][b]2.[/b] [b]Store Porch Placement Bug Fixed[/b][/h3][p]We’ve fixed a bug that prevented placing Commodity Storage or Box Storage in certain areas on the store’s porch. You should now be able to utilize this space more effectively.[/p][p]
Thank you so much for being part of this journey. If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a review, it really helps! And if you have feedback or suggestions, feel free to drop by the Discussions section.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3706960"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: v0.2.10 - Polishing, Balancing & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Ranch Farmers! 🧑🏻‍🌾[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your valuable input through both in-app feedback and the Steam Discussion forums, we’ve been able to implement several updates. We’re excited to bring you another update for the [b]Demo version[/b] of [b]Ranch Farm and Store Simulator[/b]. Let’s take a look at what’s new![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Balancing Updates[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]Furniture Now Unlocks at Level 4[/b] [/p][p]To ensure a smoother gameplay curve, furniture is now available from Level 4 onwards. This helps players gradually customize their space as they progress.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Orange Cat Can Chase Wild Animals Right After Purchase[/b][/p][p]In this update, the Orange Cat Guardian has been enhanced. Unlike the Beagle Dog, it can immediately chase and scare off wild animals automatically after being purchased, providing immediate support in protecting your farm.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/a0f3947bf77d291b2a9e1d1c6ddde6ff8c09c554.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Inventory Storage Moved to Level 5[/b] [/p][p]Inventory expansion is now available at Level 5 instead of earlier. This change spaces out progression and adds a sense of reward.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/78c7c282a84317211d1225b9be82b0bd42b69a43.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fishing Distance Made Shorter[/b] [/p][p]You can now fish from a closer range, making fishing easier and more accessible. This small tweak improves convenience without reducing challenge.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/fc5c86df6796d100e8ffa4bf7d71e7981577b74d.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Wool Pricing Increased[/b][/p][p]Wool now sells for a higher price than apples, making it a more profitable resource. This helps balance product values across the farm economy.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/c3447ed45edd152c37274f2e1dec672a256630bd.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]QoL Updates[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]Guardian UI Shows Price Before Unlock[/b] [/p][p]You can now see the price of locked Guardians in the UI. This transparency helps players plan and save up for their farm protectors.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Furniture Bonus Effects[/b][/p][p]We’ve verified that furniture bonus effects are now properly applied in-game. This ensures that your purchases bring real advantages.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cashier Bonus Effect Visible in UI[/b] [/p][p]Bonus effects from furniture are now clearly shown on the cashier interface. You’ll be able to see exactly how your setup impacts operations.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes & Visual Adjustments[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]Lake Wave Animation Adjustment[/b][/p][p]We’ve adjusted the lake wave animation to be slower and smoother. The horizontal and vertical wave motion now flows at half the previous speed for a more relaxing visual.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/53de43efdbbb4ce99bd607fb97d48162d74dcd9b.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fish Commodity Mesh Now Displays Properly[/b] [/p][p]Previously, the 3D mesh of fish disappeared when placed in the commodity inventory. This has been resolved and your fish will now appear correctly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fish Box Clipping When Overfilling Food Bowl[/b][/p][p]Previously, placing fish boxes into an overfilled food bowl caused them to get stuck. This has been resolved so feeding your animals is now smoother and bug-free.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/098323e95e218ee21839de606a60b40bfe856f0a.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Wool Harvesting Bug with Employees[/b]
There was an issue where employees couldn’t harvest wool properly. This has now been fixed, and your workers can collect wool without any problems.[/p][/*][*][p][b]3D Audio Channels Fixed[/b]
The left and right 3D audio channels were inverted, making directional sounds feel off. This has been corrected by rotating the sound source by 180 degrees.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Orange Size Adjusted for Consistency[/b]
Oranges placed in boxes, shelves, and inventory were smaller than the ones on the tree. Their size has now been increased to match the tree fruit visuals more accurately.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Plant Naming Corrections[/b]
Plant types are now properly categorized and named as trees, plants, shrubs, or bushes. This improves clarity in classification and item management.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fishing Rod Translation Fix[/b]
The translation for “Traditional Fishing Rod” has been corrected for consistency and clarity across languages.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing the demo and supporting the development. Your feedback helps shape what’s next. Try the latest build and let us know what you think. 🐓🥬[/p][p][/p][p]We always open to all feedback and suggestions to make this game as mature as possible. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, don’t hesitate to share your thoughts.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3706960/Ranch_Farm_and_Store_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: v0.1.50 - Fishing, Duck, & Wild Animal Setting
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Ranch Farmers! 🧑🏻‍🌾[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your valuable input through both in-app feedback and the Steam Discussion forums, we’ve been able to implement several updates. We’re excited to bring you another update for the [b]Demo version[/b] of [b]Ranch Farm and Store Simulator[/b]. Let’s take a look at what’s new![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Feature Updates[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]Wild Animal Attacking Feature Survey[/b][/p][p]We’ve added an in-game popup survey to gather your thoughts on the Wild Animal Attacking feature. This helps us understand how players feel about the mechanic directly from within the game. notes.title: v0.1.39 - Introducing The Guardians: Your New Farm Companion
notes.content:
Hello, Ranch Farmers! 🌱

We’re excited to bring you another update for the [b]Demo version[/b] of [b]Ranch Farm and Store Simulator[/b]! In this update, we are introducing a brand new feature that will help you protect your farm, meet the [b]Guardian[/b]!

[h1][b]Introducing Guardian[/b][/h1]

[b]Your First Farm Guardian: The Beagle Dog[/b]
Starting in the Demo, you can now get your very first [b]Guardian[/b] to help safeguard your farm. The first Guardian you’ll meet is a loyal [b]Beagle Dog[/b], always ready to assist you when wild animals come inside your farm.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/5941ec8923d86159fd8d04d9e57a36056d4ced18.png"][/img]
[b]How It Works in the Demo[/b]
When a wild animal enters your farm area, your Guardian will [b]alert[/b] you and indicate the direction where the intruder is located. This will help you react faster and protect your animals and crops.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/168c12defe4ac199c23641c9b9af509c0020a000.png"][/img]
[b]More Guardian Abilities and Types Coming After Demo[/b]
In this initial Demo version, the Guardian focuses on alerting you to the presence of wild animals. But this is just the beginning! In future updates after the Demo, we will be adding more advanced abilities, such as helping you actively [b]drive away wild animals[/b] and other exciting features to make farm protection more dynamic. Other things that you will find on later updates we will introducing other guardians type too to help in your farm. We’ll be revealing these new abilities and new types of guardian step by step in future Devlogs, so stay tuned!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/bafea6307eeae99b87b7d128b8ee863eba5e4092.png"][/img]
[b]How to Unlock Guardian in Demo[/b]
You will be able to access your Guardian once you reach [b]Level 3[/b] in the Demo. We encourage you to try it out and if you have any fun ideas or feedback on how to improve the Guardian feature, we’d love to hear them! Your experiences in this Demo phase will help us shape the future of the Guardian system.

As always, thank you for being part of our community and for continuing to share your feedback.[b]If you enjoy the game, we’d really appreciate it if you could leave feedbacks in our steam discussion page.[/b]

Your support helps us improve and grow Ranch Farm and Store Simulator for everyone.
Happy farming and see you in the next update!

notes.title: v0.1.31 - Wild Animals, Livestock Waste, and More
notes.content:
Hello, Farmers! 🧑🏻‍🌾

Thank you so much for playing our game and for being an incredible part of our journey. Your feedback, whether through discussion comments, in-game feedback, or other channels, has been invaluable to us. We truly appreciate your passion and insights as they help us improve and grow together.

Now, we’re excited to bring you the latest update for Ranch Farm & Store Simulator. This patch will include exciting new features and challenges. Here's what's new:

[h2]Feature Updates[/h2]
[b]1. Wild Animals Can Now Attack Your Farm[/b]
Farms aren’t always peaceful. Wild animals can now invade your land and destroy your valuable crops and goods. Act quickly and drive them away using the new broom tool to protect your farm’s productivity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/0810bd69718067cd9c23a9d324704bd5c3732d2c.jpg[/img]

[b]2. Livestock Waste System Introduced[/b]
Your livestock now produce animal waste that must be cleaned regularly using the broom. If left uncleaned, your animals will stop producing resources. This system adds an extra layer of realism and care to your animal management.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/63582c146fcecec4a1c49495f73353ced0280fac.jpg[/img]

[b]3. Tool Mode Added[/b]
You can now activate Tool Mode using the T key, allowing for smoother tool switching and better control during tasks like sweeping, planting, or feeding.

[b]4. Carry More with Multi-Slot Hands[/b]
Item handling just got easier. Players can now carry up to three items at once during hand mode, streamlining transportation around the ranch, farm, and store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/10d95ec6d1a845ed0ff06b2e61d26411018a2fd7.jpg[/img]

[b]5. New Employees to Help You Grow[/b]
At Level 2, a cashier becomes available to manage your store operations. By Level 3, you can hire a dedicated farmhand to help with daily chores. Employees will be essential as your business expands.

We’ve added new tools, livestock, and crops to the system. Some of these are not accessible yet in the demo, but they’re laying the groundwork for upcoming content drops.

[h2]Visual Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Planter Boxes have received a visual refresh.
[*] Lighting in the cashier area has been adjusted to reduce overexposure.
[*] NPC Customers have been improved to prevent mesh overlapping issues.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Fixes and Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Livestock and product colliders no longer block player movement in pens.
[*] Fixed storage inventory to allow easier access to all slots.
[*] Resolved pricing issue with seed boxes that previously sold for $0.
[*] Updated livestock food visuals to show a single feed sack and improved the animation.
[/list]

Thank you for playing the demo and supporting the development. Your feedback helps shape what’s next. Try the latest build and let us know what you think! 🧑‍🌾🐄

We always open to all feedback and suggestions to make this game as mature as possible. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, don’t hesitate to share your thoughts. 

Cheers!

notes.title: First Update into the Field
notes.content:
Hello, ranchers and future store tycoons!

We’re beyond excited to announce our upcoming game Ranch, Farm & Store Simulator, where you’ll experience the full journey of rural life, from raising animals and growing crops to managing your own country store! Whether you’re a casual player or a management sim enthusiast, this game offers everything you need to build a thriving ranch, a productive farm, and a successful local business.

As we kick off development, we’ve made several improvements and additions to enhance the early gameplay experience:

[h3]1. Smoother New Game Transition[/h3]
We’ve replaced the initial tweening animation for store title changes with a fade-to-black effect to give the start of the game a cleaner, more immersive feel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/a70df8acfe8310430fcdd9c4d69dd9167c45a910.jpg[/img]

[h3]2. New Tools Added[/h3]
Chainsaw, Fishing Rods, Bags, and raw commodity processing machines are added in the tools menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/b6316bc0a3fecfbb0981cf2970bdee5cd612b3d3.jpg[/img]

[h3]3. Livestock Yield Balancing[/h3]
We’re working on improving the output of animal commodities. The new system will allow animals to produce larger quantities of goods steadily until the end of their lifespan, making livestock farming more rewarding in the long run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/26dea9353a6804dc10c7f4ca37ad6e70c33363e5.jpg[/img]

[h3]4. More Crop Types[/h3]
We're also developing new types of livestock and crops to expand the farming possibilities. These additions are still in progress, and we’re excited to share more once they’re ready.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/50715e2e30d1208009b4e39cb58a62ff71a1ff3d.jpg[/img]

That wraps up our very first development update for Ranch, Farm & Store Simulator!
We’re still in the early stages, but each step brings us closer to delivering a solid gameplay experience that blends ranching, farming, and store management. 

Stay tuned for more updates, and don’t forget to let us know what you’d love to see in the game. 🌾🛒

Cheers!
